facts.text: Holy Family University requires every student to complete an internship in their field along with an accompanying virtual course in order to graduate.

sources.title: Experiential Learning at Holy Family University -- A Journey of Support
sources.quote: “Every student is not only required to have an internship, but they also are required to complete a virtual course where they complete assignments, access discussion boards and self-report on their internship experiences,” Paris-Ellerbee said.
